item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Soft Glowing Phone Wallpaper

turns.text: Make me an 8-second looping video wallpaper for my phone, 9:16. Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly on a dark background. Leave the top third mostly dark for the clock. No words or sound, and no jump when it loops.

item.tests: Tests delivery of a genuinely animated seamless portrait wallpaper with a clock-safe composition, not a landscape clip padded into a phone frame.

answer_sheet.Source image: Generate it from scratch; no photo.
answer_sheet.Style and colours: Soft abstract glowing ribbons in blue and purple against a dark background.
answer_sheet.Composition: Keep the top third mostly dark and place most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable.
answer_sheet.Duration and motion: 8 seconds, slow flowing motion, and a seamless repeat.
answer_sheet.Text and audio: No words, clock graphic or sound; my phone supplies the clock.

must_haves: The deliverable is an 8-second portrait 9:16 video, with artwork filling the frame rather than a landscape image surrounded by bars.
Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons visibly move slowly against a dark background.
The top third stays mostly dark and uncluttered throughout, with the brightest ribbons concentrated lower down.
Repeated playback has no visible jump, flash or abrupt reset at the loop boundary.
There are no words, clock graphics or other interface elements baked into the video.
The video has no audible sound.

turns.text: Make me an 8-second looping video wallpaper for my phone in vertical 9:16, with soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly on a dark background. Leave the top third mostly dark for the clock. No words or sound, and make the loop seamless with no jump. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** The read-only planner estimates **192 credits** for your 8-second video using the free-plan-compatible **LTX 2.5 at 480p**, vertical 9:16, with no audio.

Cheaper options at the same rate:

| Length | Estimated credits |
|---|---:|
| 8 seconds | 192 |
| 4 seconds | 96 |
| 3 seconds | 72 |

**480p is the lowest supported resolution for this option.** Shortening it reduces credits; making the downloaded file smaller afterward wouldn’t reduce generation cost.

One important limitation: **AI generation cannot guarantee an exactly seamless loop.** I can request slow, repeating ribbon motion, a fixed camera, and matching beginning/end states, but there may still be a visible jump. An exactly seamless wallpaper is better made with procedural animation, which isn’t available through these tools.

My recommendation: **4 seconds at 96 credits** if you want an AI-generated version—keeping the blue/purple ribbons below the mostly dark top third, with no text or sound. However, I can’t verify your remaining balance with the available tools.

Would you prefer the **8-second version**, the **4-second cheaper version**, or **no generation** given the seamless-loop limitation?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — the 4-second cheaper version at 96 credits.

dialog.agent:
The planner isn’t recognizing your earlier “no sound” instruction and requires confirmation before I can start the 96-credit version:

Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?
dialog.user: Silent—no music, voice, or other sound. ok, go ahead with that

A 3-second version is estimated at **72 credits**, but I can’t verify whether your balance covers it. Would you like to try that, or stop here?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that — the 3-second version at 72 credits, silent.

Confine the ribbons and luminous glow to the lower two thirds; leave the entire top third mostly dark, uncluttered negative space for a phone clock. Fixed camera, gentle elegant flowing motion, soft diffuse glow. One continuous shot. Design a seamless 4-second loop: slow periodic undulation completing exactly one cycle, with the final ribbon arrangement, brightness and velocity matching the first frame. No jump, no cuts, no fade in or out. No words, letters, captions, logos or watermarks. Completely silent.
